root_idea.summary: The root centers on separation, coming apart, and the absence of union, extending to dispersed groups and things that differ from one another.
root_idea.development: Its semantic development runs from a collective or state of affairs breaking apart to separated groups, diverse kinds, physically spaced elements, and expressions of wide difference.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Retained as the classical adjective/noun citation form شَتَّى.
The Quranic plural أَشْتَات is presented under its supported singular dictionary citation form شَتٌّ.

senses.definition: Varied, diverse, or different from one another.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of things or courses that are not alike; in مِنْ نَبَاتٍ شَتَّى, it describes plants of different kinds.

senses.definition: Disunited, divergent, or lacking mutual accord.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a collective whose members or parts are not united; in قُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّى, it describes hearts unlike those brought together in accord.

senses.definition: Separate or scattered groups; people or units existing apart from one another.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural أَشْتَات is used for people or groups who come, go, or are situated separately rather than as one unified body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become dissolved, broken up, disorganized, or dispersed; to lose the unity of a people, party, or state of affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive verb describing a collective, a state of affairs, or a party that breaks apart or becomes unsettled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break up, disorganize, disperse, or disunite something or a group; also, to discompose a person's mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use, including the separation of people and the disturbance of a state of affairs or mental state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become distinct or clear to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare Form IV use in which something becomes discernible or clear to the person addressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of separation, disunion, dispersion, or disorder; a disparate collection of persons or things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to affairs, peoples, parties, assemblies, or things whose members are distinct; an assembly may consist of people from different bodies or tribes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having teeth that are separate or spaced apart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional anatomical description, especially of separated or wide-spaced foreteeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Different or widely separated are two things; an expression of marked difference or distance between them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the fixed comparison شَتَّانَ بَيْنَهُمَا and related constructions, with the sense that the relation or interval between the two is greatly severed or far apart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Different or widely different from one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative use with بَيْنَ, as in شَتَّى بَيْنَ شَيْئَيْنِ, expressing a pronounced difference between two matters.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Intransitive breaking apart and dispersion are represented.
Causative separation and disorganization are represented.
Distinct or clear to someone is represented.
The noun's separation, disunion, and dispersion meaning is represented.
Diversity of kinds, disunion, scattered groups, and the broader disparate-collection use are represented.
The anatomical use for spaced teeth is represented.
The fixed expression of wide difference is represented.
The associated meanings of separation, distance, and wide difference are represented.
The comparative use of شَتَّى is represented.

cautions: The canonical QAC root شتت is matched to the contracted Lane and Maqayis root شت; the Quranic form and occurrence data remain those supplied by QAC.
